title: On the Pricing of American Options under Stochastic Local Volatility and Stochastic Correlation via the RBSDE Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.01187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we study the pricing of American options under stochastic local volatility (SLV) models extended by including stochastic correlation driven by an additional stochastic process. We generalize the class of SLV models by incorporating a flexible stochastic correlation structure. To price options within these extended models, we derive the corresponding reflected forward-backward stochastic differential equations (RBSDEs) and employ data-driven numerical methods to solve them for both pricing and hedging purposes. The RBSDE framework enables the modelling of the future evolution of the option price. Furthermore, we conduct a convergence analysis of the proposed numerical method and present numerical experiments that illustrate the performance of the extended models, as well as the accuracy and efficiency of the RBSDE-based approach.

translated_title: 基于RBSDE框架的随机局部波动率与随机相关性下美式期权定价研究
translated_abstract: 本文研究在随机局部波动率（SLV）模型下的美式期权定价问题，该模型通过引入由额外随机过程驱动的随机相关性进行了扩展。我们通过纳入灵活的随机相关结构，推广了SLV模型类。为了在这些扩展模型中对期权进行定价，我们推导了相应的反射正倒向随机微分方程（RBSDE），并采用数据驱动的数值方法求解这些方程，以实现定价和对冲的目的。RBSDE框架能够对期权价格的未来演化进行建模。此外，我们对所提出的数值方法进行了收敛性分析，并通过数值实验展示了扩展模型的性能，以及基于RBSDE方法的准确性和效率。
tldr: 该论文将随机局部波动率模型扩展至随机相关结构，推导出反射正倒向随机微分方程（RBSDE）框架，并采用数据驱动的数值方法实现美式期权在扩展模型下的定价、对冲及收敛性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper extends stochastic local volatility models with stochastic correlation, derives the corresponding RBSDE framework, and employs data-driven numerical methods for American option pricing and hedging with convergence analysis.
